resources.string: Your tablet\'s button deck. Pair it with a computer running PerritoDeck Host.
Start PerritoDeck Host on your computer. It shows a QR code you can scan with this tablet\'s camera, or a 6-digit code to enter here.
On the computer, open PerritoDeck and choose Pair a tablet: it shows a 6-digit code. (The command-line host prints one when started with --pair.)
Check that the computer shows the same fingerprint. If it doesn\'t, something on your network may be pretending to be it.
Point the camera at the QR code PerritoDeck Host shows on your computer.
Perrito needs the camera only to read the pairing code. You can also pair by typing the 6-digit code instead.
